independence_evidence.construction: Compiled allocator excludes every live extent; shared-prefix reuse copies when an extent is occupied.
independence_evidence.limit: Extent base addresses are not exposed in health; this combines the pinned allocation logic with live capacity/replay evidence.
independence_evidence.runtime: Two full-window C32 waves, all32 decoding concurrently, fixed-seed full-output replay parity.

switching.failure_recovery_scope: Automatic fallback and preflight refusals covered by controller tests; successful stock/Keys switches rehearsed on hardware.

retained_stock_output_comparison.scope: Existing fixed-fixture benchmark responses across the retained and new stock runtimes; no extra requests and no quality claim.

stability.deep_request_scope: Single synthetic cold requests interleaved with stability traffic; not a repeated or matched deep-context benchmark campaign.
stability.limits: Half-hour bounded diagnostic; not a full release-endurance or long-term leak-freedom claim.
findings: 25 mixed cycles, two cold deep requests (32768 and131072 contexts),1085 requests and75139 generated tokens passed over2086.31 seconds including final normalization/idle observation.
209 samples per host: no observer/host probe errors, watchdog failures, API health errors, missing host samples, graph-budget or runtime-shape violations.
No rank continuity failure, new host/container OOM event, poisoned runtime or RDMA failure; existing historical head oom_kill counter stayed1.

Matched quiet windows both have64 retained states,427819008 snapshot bytes and64 graph entries. Head anonymous-plus-swap grew2428928 bytes (2.3164MiB); worker2301952 bytes (2.1953MiB). This bounded result gives no evidence of material retained-memory growth.

Head RSS rose55.6MB while swap decreased; combining anonymous memory and swap avoids attributing swapped-in pages to a leak. Available memory decreased54.61MiB on the head and increased1.75MiB on the worker.
Minimum MemAvailable:3068604416 bytes head (2.85786GiB),3835244544 bytes worker (3.57185GiB), above the unchanged2GiB floor.
Full8650752 logical-token pool,32slots,1048576 context andKeys overlay remained selected. All21finite checks and both48wave benchmark campaigns already passed.
Long-duration endurance and model-quality/refusal-rate evaluation are outside this bounded acceptance.

lan_serving.scope: Small synthetic startup checks on the newly launched LAN pair; not a repeat of capacity or endurance qualification.

request_memory_regression.status: replacement passed complete finite and bounded diagnostic qualification
request_memory_regression.stage: C32 full262k raw completion admission after 19 passing finite gates
request_memory_regression.remediation: Parse and validate direct OpenAI bodies in scratch; retain only an independently owned request plan and release the JSON tree before generation. Full-window typed plan storage is bounded below2MiB by a native regression.

host_cache_budget_regression.status: replacement passed complete finite and bounded diagnostic qualification

stock_performance_regression_check.scope: Separate complete stock campaigns on the same pair and public fixtures, three scored repetitions plus warmup per group; not an interleaved causal measurement. Both runs preserve all waves.

privacy_pattern_scan.scope: Changed/new source and evidence scanned for local deployment paths, private LAN addresses, HF token patterns and private-key blocks; no installation journals or weights included.

limitations: Finite functional and capacity checks do not establish model quality or a refusal-rate change.
Half-hour mixed-load observation is not long-duration endurance qualification.
C32 full-context uses a primed shared document with independent active reservations; it is not 32 unique cold prefills.
Stock and Keys may generate different tokens; matched throughput is not an isolated kernel-speed comparison.
